title: Search a list
summary: There is no index to jump to: check one node at a time from head.

checkpoints.text: Looking for 15. A linked list has no index like an array, so the only way in is through `head`: `current` starts at the first node.
15 is found in the third node, after three comparisons. The function returns at once and the rest of the list is never looked at.
Looking for 23: `current` checked all four nodes and walked off the end to NULL. The worst case visits every node, so search is O(n).
`cout` prints a `bool` as 1 (true) or 0 (false), so the output is 1 and then 0.
